lock.name: Cases on top
lock.say: overstock and empties kept on the top shelf
lock.step: Stack the cases on the top shelf, lightest last, clear of the ceiling.
lock.caution: Keep 18 in under the ceiling tiles and the camera's view clear.

lock.name: LOCK THE ___ IN sign
lock.say: the shelf's name, on the left post
lock.step: Screw the sign's two stand-offs to the left front post and hang the sign on them.

lock.name: Label cards and orange cards
lock.say: colour code on every bin front; orange cards flag the top rows
lock.mat: Card stock in a clear sleeve
lock.fix: Slid into the bin's label holder
lock.step: Slip a colour card into each bin's label holder; tuck orange cards on the rows that need flagging.

lock.name: Hopper bins and goods
lock.say: blue-coded bins and the slanted divider cubbies' contents
lock.mat: Polypropylene bins; goods by shape only
lock.fix: Sit on the shelf, no fixings
lock.step: Slide the hopper bins onto each shelf, open fronts out, heaviest goods on the lower shelves.
lock.caution: Keep the top-shelf bins light; the step stool is there for a reason.

lock.name: End panel and sway braces, left
lock.say: closes the left end; X straps keep the run square
lock.mat: Painted steel sheet; flat steel straps, 1-1/4 in
lock.fix: Panel clipped to the posts, straps bolted at each corner
lock.step: Clip the end panel to the outside of the left posts, then bolt the two sway straps corner to corner over it, one over the other.

lock.name: End panel and sway braces, right
lock.mat: Painted steel sheet; flat steel straps
lock.fix: Panel clipped to the posts, straps bolted at each corner
lock.step: Close the right end the same way: panel, then the two straps.

lock.name: Shelf bolts
lock.say: nut and bolt through each shelf corner and the angle post
lock.step: Put a bolt through each shelf corner and the post, nuts inside, and snug them once the unit is square.

lock.name: Shelves
lock.say: box-formed steel shelves, eight per unit
lock.fix: Four bolts into the angle posts
lock.step: Set the bottom, top and one middle shelf first to square the unit, then fill in the rest at the hole rows.
lock.caution: Bolt every corner before loading; a shelf on two bolts can tip.

lock.name: Back panels
lock.step: Clip the back panel (or the centre panels, one per gap) between the rear posts.

lock.name: Angle posts
lock.say: four per unit, a hole row every 1-1/2 in
lock.step: Stand the four angle posts at the corners of the footprint, hole rows facing out to the front and back.

desk2.fix: Screwed to the pedestal and end panel
desk2.step: Screw the wood top down to the pedestal and end panel.

desk2.name: Drawer fronts
desk2.step: Hang the three drawer fronts and their pulls.

desk2.name: End panel
desk2.say: carries the west end of the top
desk2.step: Fix the end panel at the west end.

desk2.name: Drawer pedestal
desk2.step: Stand the drawer pedestal at the east end against the south wall.

coolers.name: Glass doors
coolers.say: insulated glass in a frame, a long pull
coolers.step: Hang the glass doors on their pins and check they self-close.

coolers.name: Lit headers
coolers.say: the blue light box on top
coolers.step: Fix the lit header boxes on top and plug them in.

coolers.name: Shelves and drinks
coolers.say: four wire shelves of cans and bottles each
coolers.mat: Coated wire shelves; drinks by shape only
coolers.step: Clip the wire shelves in and load them, cans low, bottles high.

coolers.name: Cabinet tops
coolers.step: The roof liner is part of the cabinet.

coolers.name: Near side panels
coolers.step: The near side panels are part of the foamed cabinet.

coolers.name: Cabinets
coolers.say: back, far side, base grille and compressor bay
coolers.step: Set both cabinets side by side, backs to the east wall and doors toward desk 2, levelled, with an air gap behind.
coolers.caution: Leave the rear grille clear; the compressor needs the air.

tables.name: Cases, cartons, trays and tins
tables.say: open cases (some stuffed with tissue), trays of black grinder tins, stacked green cartons
tables.mat: Corrugated board; tins by shape only
tables.step: Lay out the open cases, the trays of grinder tins and the stacked green cartons.

tables.name: Tote under the table
tables.step: Slide the tote under the first table.

tables.name: Table tops
tables.say: white blow-moulded tops on a steel apron
tables.step: Turn the tables over onto their legs.

tables.name: Folding legs
tables.step: Unfold the legs and lock the braces.

stacks.name: Upper cases
stacks.say: the top layers of each stack
stacks.step: Stack the upper cases, squared on the ones below.

stacks.name: Bottom cases and bags
stacks.say: the first two layers of each tower, and the piles of clear bags
stacks.step: Set the bottom cases on the floor, labels out, and pile the bags of goods.

stool.name: Treads
stool.say: two white steps on a cross arm
stool.step: Fit the treads and their cross arm between the frames; they lock as the stool opens.

stool.name: Side frames
stool.say: two black tube frames, front and back legs
stool.step: Stand the two side frames up, legs on the floor.

fans.name: Fan bodies
fans.step: Twist each fan body onto its base and plug it in.

door.name: Door leaf, hardware and framed print
door.say: grey-sage leaf, three hinges, lever, closer, kick plate and a framed print
door.mat: Painted steel leaf, brushed hardware, paper print
door.step: Hang the leaf on its three hinges, fit the lever and the closer, hang the framed print on the inside face.

door.name: Frame
door.say: hollow-metal frame: two jambs and the head
door.step: The hollow-metal frame, two jambs and the head, is anchored in the wall.

hatch.name: Sill
hatch.say: hardwood sill board through the opening, its nosing just proud of the wall
hatch.step: Fit the hardwood sill board through the opening.

hatch.name: Small grey door
hatch.say: closes the service window to the retail floor
hatch.step: Hang the small grey door in the recess.

hatch.name: Casing
hatch.say: frames the opening on the room side
hatch.step: Nail the casing round the opening.
